tasks.short: Meet applicants to gather a loan application and answer process questions.

steps.what: Arrange the appointment and send the intake checklist
Interview the applicant about their purpose, circumstances and questions
Check the received identity, income and property documents against the intake checklist

loop.input: submitted identity, income and property documents
loop.output: fielded intake record with missing items and source links
loop.check: the officer checks identity, totals, document dates and mismatches against the originals
loop.stop: stop when a required document is absent, unreadable or contradictory; issue a manual request
loop.why_not_simpler: Applicants submit different document layouts, while the required fields and checks are fixed.

steps.what: Create the application record and assign the next assessment step

tasks.design: A {WORKFLOW} form creates the appointment, checklist and case record from the enquiry. A bounded extraction reads submitted evidence into named fields, but the {CRM} keeps links to the originals and the loan officer conducts the interview and resolves missing evidence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Appointment details, notes and attachments were copied between mailbox, calendar and case record.
tasks.enabler_now: A form can require intake fields and a bounded extraction can map varied documents into the checklist.
tasks.still_hard: The officer must understand the applicant's circumstances, obtain meaningful consent and handle unclear evidence.
tasks.human_edge: A loan officer can ask follow-up questions, judge whether an applicant understands the process and respond with care.

ambition.what: Offer a guided pre-application appointment to applicants who arrive with incomplete documents.

tasks.altitude: The officer spends less time arranging and rekeying intake, and more time on the applicant conversation and difficult evidence.

reach.task: Identify whether an applicant needs broader debt or budgeting advice
reach.learn: Recognise affordability warning signs and make a warm referral.

evidence.claim: A lender can receive consented public-source application data through an integration.

assumptions: The boundary starts with an enquiry and ends with a complete application record ready for assessment.
The intake contract holds applicant ID, contact details, consent state, appointment time, loan purpose, document type, document date and source link; the applicant or officer supplies each field.
Missing fields are entered by the officer and unreadable documents are routed to a manual request.
Native case-system appointment, checklist and required-field configuration is tested before custom code.
One hour per 100 focal-role baseline hours is allowed for reviewing changed checklist rules and extraction exceptions.
unknowns: Which identity and income documents the lender accepts for each product.
Whether the applicant portal can capture consent and document provenance.
research_questions: What share of applications arrive with all required documents?
Which document mismatches create the most back-and-forth?

already_counted.description: Officer review of extracted evidence and missing items

incremental.description: Review changing document checklist rules and extraction exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes most applicants need a live interview and document correction; one upkeep hour per 100 baseline hours is deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess financial status, credit and property evidence for loan feasibility.

steps.what: Collect the consented financial, credit and property evidence for the case
Reconcile income, existing commitments, credit history and valuation evidence

loop.input: credit report, income evidence, valuation and loan criteria
loop.output: line-by-line credit analysis with source links and exceptions
loop.check: the officer ties each material figure and identity to the source record before relying on it
loop.stop: stop on conflicting amounts, stale valuation, missing consent or an unexplained credit item; return the case for clarification
loop.why_not_simpler: Source documents and explanatory notes vary, while a model must not decide loan feasibility.

steps.what: Calculate affordability ratios and repayment scenarios
Judge feasibility and write the recommendation with material caveats

tasks.design: A {WORKFLOW} case assembles consented evidence, applies deterministic ratio calculations and retains every source link in the {CRM}. A bounded reconciliation produces a reviewable analysis; the loan officer judges feasibility and owns the recommendation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence, calculations and narrative were assembled separately and a figure could lose its source trail.
tasks.enabler_now: Integration and deterministic calculation can prepare the evidence bundle and scenarios, while a bounded loop can make the reconciliation readable.
tasks.still_hard: Material credit risk, exceptional circumstances and a fair explanation remain accountable human judgements.
tasks.human_edge: The officer can weigh a coherent but unusual financial story and explain what would change the recommendation.

ambition.what: Review a daily queue of fully evidenced borderline applications rather than waiting for manual spreads.

tasks.altitude: The officer tests exceptions and lending criteria instead of compiling figures and repeating calculations.

reach.task: Review a structured risk submission with traceable evidence
reach.learn: Compare rule outputs with material exceptions.

evidence.claim: Moody's Credit Memo drafts credit memos from spreads, deal documents and a bank template.
Credit scoring of natural persons is described as high-risk AI in Annex III.

assumptions: The boundary starts with consented evidence collection and ends with a feasibility recommendation, not a loan decision.

The analysis contract contains applicant ID, consent timestamp, source record version, income, commitments, credit items, property value, requested amount, rate, term, ratio outputs and exception reason; the case system and approved providers produce the fields.
A missing or unreadable source is shown as an exception rather than inferred; an officer obtains it manually.
Native loan-system calculation and approval configuration is tested before custom calculations are built.
Two hours per 100 focal-role baseline hours are allowed for monitoring data mappings, policy changes and reconciliation exceptions.
unknowns: Which external data sources and property valuation feeds are available with applicant consent.
Which ratio thresholds are binding versus advisory for each lending product.
research_questions: How often do source amounts disagree across documents?
Which exceptions lead to a different feasibility recommendation after officer review?

already_counted.description: Officer review of reconciled evidence and material exceptions

incremental.description: Monitor evidence mappings and policy-rule changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes incomplete evidence and frequent exception review; two upkeep hours per 100 baseline hours are deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Approve loans within authority limits or refer them to management.

steps.what: Check that the application is complete and compare amount, risk flags and authority limit
Approve, decline or request clarification for a case within personal authority
Route an outside-limit case and its frozen evidence snapshot to management
Review the outside-limit referral and record the management decision

tasks.design: The {WORKFLOW} flow checks a versioned authority matrix and case completeness in the {CRM}. It records within-limit decisions by the authorised officer and routes outside-limit cases only with a frozen evidence snapshot for the credit manager's decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Authority checks and referrals rely on manual reading of limits, email attachments and status updates.
tasks.enabler_now: An authority matrix and case status can be evaluated deterministically, with a versioned workflow referral.
tasks.still_hard: A limit does not remove the need to judge risk, record rationale or manage an exceptional case.
tasks.human_edge: Authorised people remain accountable for a lending decision and can recognise when a seemingly complete case has a material concern.

ambition.what: Give credit managers a daily queue of outside-limit cases with complete, version-bound referrals.

tasks.altitude: The officer audits decision quality and exception patterns instead of chasing referral status.

reach.task: Apply a documented authority limit and escalate an exception
reach.learn: Use versioned policy rules and write a concise escalation rationale.

evidence.claim: The digest recommends rules over every record with exceptions routed to a person for financial checks.

assumptions: The boundary starts when a complete credit memo is ready and ends when the authorised officer or manager records a decision.

The authority contract contains case ID, decision amount, product, risk flags, officer authority level, policy version, case snapshot version, status and decision rationale; the case system produces these fields.
A missing limit, stale matrix or changed evidence snapshot stops the route and returns the case to a human.
Native loan-system authority rules and approval routing are tested before custom workflow code.
One hour per 100 focal-role baseline hours is allowed for authority-matrix updates and exception-route monitoring.
unknowns: How often applications exceed the officer's authority limit.
Whether the lender's decision log can bind an approval to an immutable evidence snapshot.
research_questions: Which limit changes cause the most misroutes today?
How long do outside-limit cases wait for a management decision?

incremental.description: Maintain authority rules and inspect referral-route exceptions

approvals.approved_version: case snapshot version attached to referral

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes many referrals need an officer narrative or a corrected snapshot; one upkeep hour per 100 focal-role baseline hours is deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Explain suitable loan and credit options and their terms to customers.

steps.what: Retrieve approved product terms, eligibility prompts and current rate information
Prepare a plain-language comparison of relevant options and disclosed terms

loop.input: approved terms and the customer's stated question
loop.output: plain-language option comparison with source clauses
loop.check: the officer checks every rate, fee, eligibility condition and disclaimer against the approved terms
loop.stop: stop when the request needs suitability advice, terms are missing or a product change is pending; use the approved document and escalate
loop.why_not_simpler: The source facts are controlled, but the customer's question and wording vary.

steps.what: Discuss options with the customer, answer questions and check their understanding
Record the topics explained and create promised follow-up work

tasks.design: An {OTHER} approved-content register supplies current terms to an {WORKFLOW} answer desk and logs the sources used in the {CRM}. It can prepare a comparison and record follow-up, while the loan officer remains responsible for the explanation and checking understanding.
tasks.previous_blocker: Officers search several product documents, rewrite terms for each call and re-enter the same case note.
tasks.enabler_now: Approved content and structured product fields can be retrieved consistently; a bounded drafting step can prepare plain language.
tasks.still_hard: The officer must avoid unsuitable advice, respond to uncertainty and make sure the customer understands material terms.
tasks.human_edge: The officer can adapt an explanation to a customer's question and notice confusion or pressure that a prepared answer cannot resolve.

ambition.what: Offer a documented plain-language terms conversation to customers who need extra explanation before applying.

tasks.altitude: The officer improves the answer library from recurring questions rather than searching and copying clauses.

reach.task: Handle a standard terms question with an approved answer
reach.learn: Use source-linked content and recognise when to escalate to a loan officer.

evidence.claim: A product that drafts credit memos from a template and source documents is described in the digest, supporting bounded drafting rather than unsupervised advice.

assumptions: The boundary starts with a customer question and ends with a logged explanation and any follow-up task, not a lending decision.

The explanation contract contains product ID, product-version date, rate and fee fields, eligibility conditions, source-clause link, customer question, explained topics and follow-up owner; approved content owners publish the terms.
If a term is not in the approved register or the question needs suitability advice, the officer uses the source document and escalates.
Native CRM knowledge, task and note features are tested before a custom answer desk.
One hour per 100 focal-role baseline hours is allowed for content version checks and review of unsafe or unanswered questions.
unknowns: Which product terms change most often and who approves their customer wording.
Whether calls or meetings need a specific disclosure record.
research_questions: Which questions lead to the longest customer conversations?
How often do customers ask for clarification after the initial explanation?

already_counted.description: Officer check of prepared comparison against approved terms

incremental.description: Review content changes and unsafe answer-desk exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes a live conversation and personalised follow-up are still needed; one upkeep hour per 100 baseline hours is deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Run a daily exception review across incomplete applications, credit evidence and authority routes.
reach: personal financial advisor: recognise when an applicant needs broader budgeting or debt advice
role.ambitious_version: Give more applicants a complete, understandable path from enquiry to an accountable lending decision.
